integrity: Analytical proof for all positive shapes, with independently replayable finite numerical diagnostics; diagnostic samples are not proof of universal claims.
scientific_limitations: Two coordinate blocks with a common positive scale within each block; arbitrary full multi-scale vectors are not classified.
Implicit one-dimensional beta-expectation thresholds rather than general elementary closed forms.
A related 2024 dissertation was only accessible as bibliographic abstract; historical-priority uncertainty remains.
No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Universal covariance phase diagram for projectively stretched spherical-Dirichlet vectors
